info.title: ExcelRenderer command-line tool
info.description: Convert Excel XLSX files to PDF, PNG and AI-friendly Markdown.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Convert Excel files to PDF, PNG, SVG and Markdown.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: xlsx
commands.description: Map JSON into an Excel template and save XLSX without rendering.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the mapped XLSX file.

options.name: --data
options.description: JSON data file to map into the XLSX template before output.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output PDF file.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: Worksheet name to convert.

options.name: --hyperlinks
options.description: Cell hyperlinks: preserve or none. [default: preserve]

options.name: --data
options.description: JSON data file to map into the XLSX template before output.

options.name: --font-dir
options.description: Additional font directory (repeatable).

options.name: --font-file
options.description: TrueType/OpenType font file to register (repeatable; .ttf, .tte, and supported .otf contents are accepted).

options.name: --fallback-font
options.description: Fallback font family, in priority order (repeatable).

options.name: --no-system-fonts
options.description: Do not search operating-system fonts. [default: False]

options.name: --font-policy
options.description: Font policy: bundled or requested. [default: bundled]

options.name: --ivs-font-style
options.description: Bundled IVS font style: gothic or mincho. [default: gothic]

commands.name: render
commands.description: Render an Excel workbook using the unified rendering API.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file for PDF, or output directory for other formats.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: pdf, png, svg, or markdown.

options.name: --sheet
options.description: Worksheet name to render.

options.name: --pages
options.description: Document pages to render, for example: 1,3-5.

options.name: --image-layout
options.description: Image layout for PNG/SVG: paginated or continuous. [default: paginated]

options.name: --range
options.description: Explicit A1 rectangle, optionally sheet-qualified. Repeat once per sheet.

options.name: --max-range-cells
options.description: Maximum total explicit range cells. [default: 1000000]

options.name: --trim
options.description: Crop each page or canvas around visible drawing content. [default: False]

options.name: --trim-padding
options.description: Nonnegative crop padding in points (default: 2). Requires --trim.

options.name: --hyperlinks
options.description: Cell hyperlinks: preserve or none. [default: preserve]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat all warnings and errors as conversion failures. [default: False]

options.name: --warnings-as-errors
options.description: Diagnostic code to treat as an error.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Optional path for the conversion manifest JSON.
